limitations: This reassessment checks code, input inventories and matching upstream execution receipts. It does not independently rerun the 99 notebooks or download the 3.3 GB of archives. No new scientific criteria are imposed.

category_definitions.source_workflow_reconstructed: Original public input bytes processed into individual measurements, fitted curves/controls and linked historical decisions; actual remote execution retained, with reconstructed continuation choices explicit.
